rationale.text: A labelled email field sits beside a text field without any label inside a paragraph hidden with display none, as anti-spam traps do. The test gives no exception for fields that are not displayed, and the text does not say whether such a field counts. The custom check answers cannot_tell for a field that is not rendered (step 1), and for the labelled one (step 3); only the record supports this branch. The finding is needs_review: not_enabled at fail_only, alternative_unresolved at full.
